properties.description:
Begin only after the user is satisfied with the implemented review surface and its UI-editor workflow in Changes. Hold a joint needs-analysis session for Task graph CRUD. Walk through moving selected work out of the earlier-MVP acceptance group and the broader task/dependency workflow.

Establish what drag and drop should mean for containment versus dependencies; how creation, inspection, editing and deletion should work; and expectations for bulk actions, cancellation, invalid drops, keyboard access and feedback. Analyze the user-visible consequences of operations that affect other relations or violate invariants, without weakening those invariants.

Record agreed needs, examples, boundaries and open questions in durable material linked to this task, keeping the task brief separate from proposal deliverables. Do not reorganize the user's live tasks as a substitute for the planned UI.
properties.title: Analyze graph-editing needs with the user
